---
title: "Funding tracker dataset QC"
format: html
---

This notebook performs QC on the project-level data that powers the SRF Funding Tracker.
The QC is performed on a state state-fiscal-year basis.

## Source scripts
```{r, warning=FALSE}
source("resources/inputs.R")
source("resources/cleaning.R")
source("resources/testing.R")
run_code_from_file("aws.txt")

```

## Read Clean Data (All Projects)
```{r}
# import project-level data
all_projects <- s3read_using(read.csv, object="s3://water-team-data/clean_data/srf_project_priority_lists/dwsrf-funding-tracker-all-projects.csv") %>%
  clean_names() |>
  dplyr::mutate(state_fiscal_year = as.character(state_fiscal_year))
```

## Create detailed QC tables
### IDs
```{r}
## IDs #####
id_columns <- c("pwsid", "project_id")

id_skim <- all_projects |>
  dplyr::select(state, state_fiscal_year, id_columns) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(id_columns),
      ~ str_replace(.x, "No Information", NA_character_
      )
    )
   ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(state, state_fiscal_year) |>
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |>
  dplyr::tibble() |>
  dplyr::select(
    -skim_type,
    -character.whitespace,
    -character.empty
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(skim_variable, state, state_fiscal_year),
    names_to = "stats",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("state", "state_fiscal_year"),
    names_from = c(stats, skim_variable),
    values_from = value
  ) |>
    janitor::clean_names() 

id_summary <- all_projects |>
  dplyr::select(state, state_fiscal_year, id_columns) |>
  dplyr::group_by(state, state_fiscal_year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    no_info_pwsid = sum(pwsid == "No Information", na.rm = TRUE),
    no_info_project_id = sum(project_id == "No Information", na.rm = TRUE),
    pwsid_count_lengths = paste(
      sort(unique(
        stringr::str_length(
          pwsid[!is.na(pwsid) & pwsid != "No Information"]
        )
      )),
      collapse = ","
    ),
    non_standard_pwsid = paste(
      pwsid[
        stringr::str_length(pwsid) != 9 &
          !is.na(pwsid) &
          pwsid != "No Information"
      ],
      collapse = ", "
    )
    )

id_qc <- id_summary |>
  dplyr::left_join(id_skim) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    no_info_project_id,
    .after = character_n_unique_pwsid
  ) |>
dplyr::mutate(
    check_pwsid = character_max_pwsid - character_min_pwsid > 0,
    check_pwsid = ifelse(is.na(check_pwsid), FALSE, check_pwsid),
    no_info_check_pwsid = 100*no_info_pwsid/n >= 10,
    
    check_duplicates_project_id = no_info_project_id +character_n_unique_project_id < n & n_missing_project_id != n,
    n_potential_duplicates_project_id = n - character_n_unique_project_id - no_info_project_id,
    no_info_check_project_id = 100*no_info_project_id/n >= 10
)

colnames(id_qc)

id_qc <- id_qc |>
  dplyr::relocate(
   "non_standard_pwsid",
   "check_pwsid",
   "no_info_check_pwsid",
   .after = character_n_unique_pwsid   
  ) |>
   dplyr::relocate(
  "pwsid_count_lengths",
  .after = character_max_pwsid
   ) 


colnames(id_qc)
```

### Text
```{r}
text_columns <- c("community_served", "borrower","project_description", "project_name" )

text_skim <- all_projects |>
  dplyr::select(state, state_fiscal_year, text_columns) |>
  dplyr::group_by(state, state_fiscal_year) |>
  skimr::skim_without_charts()
```
### Numeric
```{r}
numeric_value_columns <- c("project_cost", "requested_amount", "population")

## Numeric #####
numeric_skim <- all_projects |>
  dplyr::select(state, state_fiscal_year, numeric_value_columns) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(numeric_value_columns),
      ~ parse_number(.x, na = c("", "NA", "No Information"))
      )
    ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    state, state_fiscal_year
  ) |>
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |>
  dplyr::tibble() |>
      dplyr::select(
    -skim_type,
    -numeric.p25,
    -numeric.p75
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    min = numeric.p0,
    median = numeric.p50,
    max = numeric.p100
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(skim_variable, state, state_fiscal_year),
    names_to = "stats",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("state", "state_fiscal_year"),
    names_from = c(stats, skim_variable),
    values_from = value
  ) |>
    janitor::clean_names()

numeric_summary <- all_projects |>
  dplyr::select(state, state_fiscal_year, numeric_value_columns) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    state, state_fiscal_year
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    no_info_project_cost = sum(project_cost == "No Information", na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_project_cost = sum(project_cost == "0", na.rm = TRUE),
    no_info_requested_amount = sum(requested_amount == "No Information", na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_requested_amount = sum(requested_amount == "0", na.rm = TRUE),
    no_info_population = sum(population == "No Information", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

numeric_qc <- numeric_summary |>
  dplyr::left_join(numeric_skim) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    check_project_cost = min_project_cost < 10000  | max_project_cost > 1000000000,
    check_requested_amount = min_requested_amount < 10000  | max_requested_amount > 1000000000,
    check_population = min_population == 0
  ) |>

  dplyr::relocate(
  "zero_project_cost",
  .before = min_project_cost
    ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
  "zero_requested_amount", 
  .before = min_requested_amount
    )|>
  dplyr::relocate(
     "no_info_requested_amount",
     .before = n_missing_requested_amount
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
     "no_info_population",
     .before = n_missing_population
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
     "check_project_cost",
     .after = max_project_cost
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
     "check_requested_amount",
     .after = max_requested_amount
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
     "check_population",
     .after = max_population
  ) 


# colnames(numeric_qc)

```

### Numeric: Special
```{r}
special_numeric_value_columns <- c( "funding_amount", "principal_forgiveness")      

## Special numeric ################
special_numeric_skim <- all_projects |>
  dplyr::filter(expecting_funding == "Yes") |>
  dplyr::select(state, state_fiscal_year, special_numeric_value_columns) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(special_numeric_value_columns),
      ~ parse_number(.x, na = c("", "NA", "No Information"))
      )
    ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    state, state_fiscal_year
  ) |>
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |>
  dplyr::tibble() |>
      dplyr::select(
    -skim_type,
    -numeric.p25,
    -numeric.p75
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    min = numeric.p0,
    median = numeric.p50,
    max = numeric.p100
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(skim_variable, state, state_fiscal_year),
    names_to = "stats",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("state", "state_fiscal_year"),
    names_from = c(stats, skim_variable),
    values_from = value
  ) |>
    janitor::clean_names()

special_numeric_summary <- all_projects |>
  dplyr::select(state, state_fiscal_year, expecting_funding, special_numeric_value_columns) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(special_numeric_value_columns),
      ~ parse_number(.x, na = c("", "NA", "No Information"))
      )
    ) |>    
  dplyr::group_by(
    state, state_fiscal_year
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    n_ef = sum((expecting_funding == "Yes")),
    n_perc_g_75 = sum(expecting_funding == "Yes" & principal_forgiveness/funding_amount > 0.75),
    n_perc_e_100 = sum(expecting_funding == "Yes" & principal_forgiveness/funding_amount == 1),
    n_perc_g_100 = sum(expecting_funding == "Yes" & principal_forgiveness/funding_amount > 1), 
  )

special_numeric_summary_additional <- all_projects |>
  dplyr::filter(expecting_funding == "Yes") |>
  dplyr::select(state, state_fiscal_year, special_numeric_value_columns) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    state, state_fiscal_year
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    no_info_funding_amount = sum(funding_amount == "No Information", na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_funding_amount = sum(funding_amount == "0", na.rm = TRUE),
    no_info_principal_forgiveness = sum(principal_forgiveness == "No Information", na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_principal_forgiveness = sum(principal_forgiveness == "0", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

special_numeric_qc <- special_numeric_summary |>
  dplyr::left_join(special_numeric_summary_additional) |>
  dplyr::left_join(special_numeric_skim) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    "zero_funding_amount",
    .before = min_funding_amount
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    "zero_principal_forgiveness",
    .before = min_principal_forgiveness
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    no_info_principal_forgiveness,
    .before =n_missing_principal_forgiveness
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    dplyr::any_of(c("n_perc_g_75", "n_perc_e_100", "n_perc_g_100")),
    .after = last_col()
  )  


```


### Categorical
```{r}
categorical_value_columns <- c("project_type", "disadvantaged", "expecting_funding")

## Categorical #####  
categorical_skim <- all_projects |>
  dplyr::select(state, state_fiscal_year, categorical_value_columns) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(categorical_value_columns),
      ~ str_replace(.x, "No Information", NA_character_
      )
    )
   ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(categorical_value_columns),
      forcats::fct
      )
    ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(
    state, state_fiscal_year
  ) |>
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |>
  dplyr::select(
    -c(skim_type, factor.top_counts, factor.ordered)
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(skim_variable, state, state_fiscal_year),
    names_to = "stats",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("state", "state_fiscal_year"),
    names_from = c(stats, skim_variable),
    values_from = value
  ) |>
    janitor::clean_names()

categorical_summary <- all_projects |>
  dplyr::select(state, state_fiscal_year, categorical_value_columns) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    state, state_fiscal_year
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    no_info_project_type = sum(project_type == "No Information", na.rm = TRUE),
    distinct_project_type = paste(unique(project_type), collapse = ", "),
    no_info_disadvantaged = sum(disadvantaged == "No Information", na.rm = TRUE),
    distinct_disadvantaged = paste(unique(disadvantaged), collapse = ", "),
    no_info_expecting_funding = sum(expecting_funding == "No Information", na.rm = TRUE),
    distinct_expecting_funding = paste(unique(expecting_funding), collapse = ", ")
  )

categorical_qc <- categorical_summary |>
  dplyr::left_join(categorical_skim)|>
  dplyr::relocate(
    distinct_project_type,
    .after = factor_n_unique_project_type
    ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    no_info_disadvantaged,
    .before =n_missing_disadvantaged
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    distinct_disadvantaged,
    .after = factor_n_unique_disadvantaged
    ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    no_info_expecting_funding,
    .before =n_missing_expecting_funding
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    distinct_expecting_funding,
    .after = factor_n_unique_expecting_funding
    )

```
